enemy-054-albino-facehugger.name: Albino Facehugger
enemy-054-albino-facehugger.designLock: Exact systemic derivative of the validated V65 Facehugger: same low flattened central body, eight long articulated finger-like walking limbs in four bilateral pairs, paired ventral lobes/proboscis structure and one long flexible trailing tail; same realistic dimensions, motion, attack arc, scale, ground pivot and strict right-facing orientation. Albino changes only authored pigment/material response: pale warm ivory-beige flesh, translucent blush-pink joints and ventral tissue, faint cool gray folds and restrained wet highlights. Preserve readable segmentation and depth; never bleach to flat white or apply an automatic recolor. No extra limbs, new armor, eyes, mandibles, caste or official albino-model claim. All future pixels are original project adaptation art.
